title: The odds, the campaign, the leagues
items: Odds: a card for each hidden roll pool, with every outcome and its chance. Pools link to what they can roll.
League mechanics link to their currency, atlas passives, tablets, bosses and odds, both ways.
The Atlas page ranks the league mechanics by their share of the Currency Exchange.
Areas and Waystones show a normal monster's life and damage at that level.
Gem popups show the gold price by level and quality.
Campaign: a new page, act by act. The areas, the quests and every reward kept for good, with ticks.
A shared card link shows its price and when it was checked.
The Data page lists the open data files and how to use them.

title: The world, the market, the patches
items: World: a card for every area, quest and act. See where each area leads, who you fight there and what each quest gives.
Maps show what content they can hold, and what corrupting them can add.
Market: a new page with the price index, league start, rising fast, crafting demand, the league gap, patch shocks and weekly digests.
Currency cards show how easy they are to trade, their price by league day, and the hours they trade most.
Every card shows what each patch changed on it, in GGG's own words. Passives show when they were new, changed or renamed.
A Patches page lists every patch and hotfix with its date.
Every card popup says which patch its game data is from.

title: Know the fight
items: Boss cards show how hard each boss hits: its life, its defences and its big hits, worked out from the game files.
Keywords show the game's own numbers: culling thresholds, the party bonus and more.
Currency shows its Currency Exchange gold fee. Uniques show their gold value.
A respec calculator under the passive tree: gold a point at your level.
The map has a dot for every card, the Divine Orb and every boss included.
